facts: Parties: Eskdale Energy plc (Buyer), Quayside Foods Ltd (Seller); the Company is Juniper Technologies Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 2 December 2026; Closing is scheduled for 26 January 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,600,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 90 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 2 December 2026), either party may terminate.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 16 April 2027.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Netherby Engineering Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
